arxiv-1805-03576.title: Finslerian Ressiner-Nordstrom spacetime
arxiv-1805-03576.creator: Xin Li 1
arxiv-1805-03576.description: Abstract We have obtained Finslerian Ressiner-Nordstrom solution where it is asymptotic to a Finsler spacetime with constant flag curvature while r → ∞ r\rightarrow\infty . The covariant derivative of modified Einstein tensor in Finslerian gravitational field equation for this solution is conserved. The symmetry of the special Finslerian Ressiner-Nordstrom spacetime, namely, Finsler spacetime with constant flag curvature, has been investigated.

Zhang, Diego Altamirano, Andrej Dobrotka, Teruaki Enoto, Elizabeth C. Ferrara, Richard Ignace, Sebastian Heinz, Craig Markwardt, Joy S. Nichols, Michael L. Parker, Dheeraj R. Pasham, Songpeng
arxiv-2307-11485.description: Abstract The 2021 outburst of the symbiotic recurrent nova RS Oph was monitored with the Neutron Star Interior Composition Explorer Mission ( NICER ) in the 0.2-12 keV range from day one after the optical maximum, until day 88, producing an unprecedented, detailed view of the outburst development.

arxiv-2506-13718.title: Failure of the Flat Chain Conjecture and non-regularity of the prescribed Jacobian equation
arxiv-2506-13718.creator: Jakub Takáč
arxiv-2506-13718.description: Abstract We show that the Flat Chain Conjecture in Lang’s formulation (that is, without requiring finite mass of the underlying currents) fails for metric k k -currents in ℝ d \mathbb{R}^{d} whenever d ≥ 2 d\geq 2 and k ∈ { 1 , … , d } k\in\{1,\dots,d\} . In all other cases, it holds.

arxiv-2506-23151.title: MEMFOF: High-Resolution Training for Memory-Efficient Multi-Frame Optical Flow Estimation
arxiv-2506-23151.creator: Vladislav Bargatin, Egor Chistov, Alexander Yakovenko, Dmitriy Vatolin
arxiv-2506-23151.description: Abstract Recent advances in optical flow estimation have prioritized accuracy at the cost of growing GPU memory consumption, particularly for high-resolution (FullHD) inputs. We introduce MEMFOF, a memory-efficient multi-frame optical flow method that identifies a favorable trade-off between multi-frame estimation and GPU memory usage. pmc-11435150.title: Genetic Diversity of Tulipa alberti and T. greigii Populations from Kazakhstan Based on Application of Expressed Sequence Tag Simple Sequence Repeat Markers
pmc-11435150.creator: Moldir Yermagambetova, Shyryn Almerekova, Anna Ivashchenko, Yerlan Turuspekov, Saule Abugalieva
pmc-11435150.description: The genus Tulipa L., renowned for its ornamental and ecological significance, encompasses a diversity of species primarily concentrated in the Tian Shan and Pamir-Alay Mountain ranges. With its varied landscapes, Kazakhstan harbors 42 Tulipa species, including the endangered Tulipa alberti Regel and Tulipa greigii Regel, which are critical for biodiversity yet face significant threats from human activities.

pmc-11482606.title: Sensor-Based and Visual Behavioral Profiling of Dry Holstein Cows Presenting Distinct Median Core Body Temperatures
pmc-11482606.creator: Nicolle F. F. Bönmann, Luis G. D. Mendonça, Isabella Sellmer Ramos, Rebecca Fritz, Caio Gamarra, Douglas Duhatschek, Raphael S. S. de Oliveira, Alexandre L. A. Scanavez, Thiago S. Belem, Matthew C. Lucy, Joao G. N. Moraes
pmc-11482606.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Simple SummaryHeat stress results in significant economic losses to the dairy industry. At the individual cow level, core body temperature (CBT) serves as a reliable proxy for quantifying the degree of heat stress experienced by cows. As animals adapt their behavior to cope with heat stress, this study investigated behavioral patterns in dry Holstein cows with distinct CBT during the summer months, a season known for inducing heat stress in dairy cattle.

pmc-11547945.title: Comparing the Effectiveness of Different Dietary Educational Approaches for Carbohydrate Counting on Glycemic Control in Adults with Type 1 Diabetes: Findings from the DIET-CARB Study, a Randomized Controlled Trial
pmc-11547945.creator: Bettina Ewers, Martin Bæk Blond, Jens Meldgaard Bruun, Tina Vilsbøll, Antonio Paoli
pmc-11547945.description: Background/Objectives: Carbohydrate counting is recommended to improve glycemic control in type 1 diabetes (T1D), but the most effective educational methods are unclear. Despite its benefits, many individuals struggle with mastering carbohydrate counting, leading to inconsistent use and suboptimal glycemic outcomes. This study aimed to compare the effectiveness of two group-based programs with individual dietary counseling (standard care) for glycemic control.

pmc-11590479.title: TDO2 inhibition counters Benzo[a]pyrene-induced immune evasion and suppresses tumorigenesis in lung adenocarcinoma
pmc-11590479.creator: İsa Taş, Mücahit Varlı, Sultan Pulat, Hyun Bo Sim, Jong-Jin Kim, Hangun Kim
pmc-11590479.description: IntroductionBenzo[a]pyrene (BaP) is a toxic polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon known as an exogenous AhR ligand. This study investigates the role of BaP in inducing immune checkpoint expression in lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) and the underlying mechanisms involving the aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AhR) and tryptophan (Trp) metabolism.

pmc-11683874.title: Recent Progress in Modeling and Simulation of Biomolecular Crowding and Condensation Inside Cells
pmc-11683874.creator: Apoorva Mathur, Rikhia Ghosh, Ariane Nunes-Alves
pmc-11683874.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Macromolecular crowding in the cellular cytoplasm can potentially impact diffusion rates of proteins, their intrinsic structural stability, binding of proteins to their corresponding partners as well as biomolecular organization and phase separation. While such intracellular crowding can have a large impact on biomolecular structure and function, the molecular mechanisms and driving forces that determine the effect of crowding on dynamics and conformations of macromolecules are so far not well understood.

pmc-11700348.description: Objective:Leukemia is a group of hematologic malignancies in the bonemarrow that arise from the dysfunctional proliferation of developing leukocytes. It is classified as either acute or chronic based on the rapidity of proliferation and as myelocytic or lymphocytic based on the cell of origin.

pmc-12557936.title: Experiences with family relationships following eating disorders: a roller coaster of emotions
pmc-12557936.creator: Lisa Marie Jacobsen, Jannike Karlstad, Ragni Adelsten Stokland, Gørill Haugan, Berit Støre Brinchmann
pmc-12557936.description: BackgroundEating disorders (EDs) are life-threatening illnesses that affect both patients and their families. When a member of the family has an ED, family life is necessarily impacted, as are intrafamily relationships and communication. We aimed to shed light on patients’ and their siblings’ experiences with their family relationships during and after EDs.

pmc-13462318.title: A machine-learning approach to predict additional treatment after Bacillus Calmette-Guérin induction in non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer
pmc-13462318.creator: Philippe Pinton, Haruna Kawano, Oliver Patschan, Arjun Ravi, Atsushi Nakano, Philippe Auvaro, Apurba Mukherjee
pmc-13462318.description: Non-muscle invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC) comprises ~ 75% of newly diagnosed bladder cancer, with high-risk NMIBC associated with high rates of recurrence and progression. Nearly 40% of patients experience a lack of efficacy with gold standard Bacillus Calmette-Guérin (BCG) therapy and current methods for predicting BCG response are limited.

pmc-13473666.title: Post-gadolinium T1 alterations in Parkinson's disease and essential tremor
pmc-13473666.creator: Junsung Kim, Eunseon Jeong, Yangsean Choi, Yoonho Nam, Ho Sung Kim, Sungyang Jo, Sun Ju Chung
pmc-13473666.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Post-contrast T1 changes (ΔT1) on brain MRI may reflect alterations in cerebrospinal fluid dynamics and microvascular exchange in movement disorders. We investigated regional post-contrast ΔT1 differences in patients with idiopathic Parkinson’s disease (IPD) and essential tremor (ET). In this retrospective single-center study, 277 patients who underwent brain MRI for suspected movement disorders between November 2023 and February 2025 were classified as ET (n = 109), early IPD (n = 81), or advanced IPD (n = 87).

pmc-13617352.title: Sex-specific shape models to disentangle sex effects and age-associated anatomical variation in biventricular cardiac anatomy
pmc-13617352.creator: Stefano Buoso, Valery L Visser, Pia Leuders, Tobias Kudelka, Maximilian Fuetterer, Christina Spengler, Robert Manka, Sebastian Kozerke
pmc-13617352.description: AimsAge- and sex-related differences in cardiac anatomy are well established using conventional cardiovascular magnetic resonance biomarkers, but their representation in 3D ventricular shape remains unclear. In pooled statistical shape models, leading modes may be dominated by between-sex anatomical variation, potentially obscuring within-sex age-associated variation.

pmc-13700311.title: Exploring medical and nursing students’ perceptions of death and dying: a qualitative study using photo-elicitation interviews
pmc-13700311.creator: Wei How Darryl Ang, Ming Marcus Chua, Jin Wei Fan, Daniel Zhi Yu Ramos Oon, Jung Jae Lee, Shek Nam Marques Ng, M Kamala Devi, Laura Tham Schmidt
pmc-13700311.description: BackgroundAn individual’s perception of death and dying is influenced by multidimensional factors, including societal, relational and personal aspects. When factors such as cultural taboos and fears dominate, they can negatively shape one’s perception of death and dying. Consequently, inexperienced medical and nursing students may be more susceptible to the negative impacts of dealing with death and dying.

uslaw-usc-t34-s30109.title: 34 U.S.C. § 30109 — National strategy, classification, and reporting on cybercrime
uslaw-usc-t34-s30109.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t34-s30109.description: United States Code, Title 34 (Crime Control And Law Enforcement); Chapter 301 (Computer Crimes And Intellectual Property Crimes). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Definitions In this section: (1) Computer The term “computer” includes a computer network and any interactive electronic device. (2) Cybercrime against individuals The term “cybercrime against individuals” has the meaning given the term in section 30107 of this.

uslaw-usc-t8-s1429.title: 8 U.S.C. § 1429 — Prerequisite to naturalization; burden of proof
uslaw-usc-t8-s1429.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t8-s1429.description: United States Code, Title 8 (Aliens And Nationality); Chapter 12 (Immigration And Nationality); Subchapter III (Nationality And Naturalization); Part II (Nationality Through Naturalization). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Except as otherwise provided in this subchapter, no person shall be naturalized unless he has been lawfully admitted to the United States for permanent residence in accordance with all applicable provisions of this chapter.
